query: A staff report states that after removing price changes, Japan's output rose -0.2% in 2022, given nominal output growth of 1.4% and a deflator increase of 0.4%. Is the statement right?

text.text: Identifies that real growth is obtained by stripping the price change (GDP deflator) out of nominal GDP growth: 1+gamma=(1+g)(1+pi).

data.text: Uses WEO nominal GDP and GDP deflator series (NGDP, NGDP_D).

computation.text: Real GDP growth JPN 2022 = 0.96 %; statement of -0.2% is outside tolerance
Verdict: statement is FALSE under the recomputed value.

assembled_from: Escolano (2010) A Practical Guide to Public Debt Dynamics (doc 55319ff9-c45c-4e8d-99e4-5562a1158bf2)
provenance.selection: seeded draw over top-20 economies by 2024 USD GDP (frozen), one per country-year

gold_report_note: Published value is WEO series or none; no corpus report states it, nothing to withhold.
distractors: simple CPI deflation of nominal growth
